The office handles the recording and preservation of town records, including: * Bylaws of the Town of Boxborough * Birth, death, marriage certificates * Board of Appeals filings and decisions * Recording the annual town census and street list * Posting notification of all meetings of all town governmental bodies * Town meeting warrant and minutes certification of all actions voted at town meetings * As the Chief Records Access Officer, the Town Clerk responds to Public Records Requests ### Permits & Licenses The Town Clerk is responsible for issuing permits and licenses, including: * Burial Permits * Business Certificates * Dog Licenses * Marriage Licenses * Permits for Raffles and Bazaars ### Elections The Town Clerk is the chief election officer of the town and oversees all local, state and federal elections, including: * Certifying of candidates’ nomination papers and petition articles * Supervising voter registration * Issuing of absentee ballots * Overseeing local, state and federal elections * Reporting and certifying election results * Overseeing Campaign Finance law reporting ### Open Meeting & Conflict of Interest Law The Town Clerk is responsible for disseminating information on Open Meeting Law and Conflict of Interest Law. 1. Boxford, MA 01921 # Town Clerk The Town Clerk's responsibilities include overseeing elections, registering voters, recording official actions of Town Meeting, conducting the annual census, and preserving official town documents. In addition, the Clerk records births, marriages and deaths, administers the oath of office to town officials, issues licenses, posts meetings of governmental bodies, provides access to public records and provides local officials with information regarding the Open Meeting Law and Conflict of Interest Law.
